newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick closes Mongoose bicycle purchase.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick closes Mongoose bicycle purchase.

text.p: Brunswick Corp said Tuesday it had completed the purchase of the inventory and trademark of the Mongoose bicycle and parts business of Bell Sports Corp for about $22 million.

This business markets a complete line of bicycles, including BMX, mountain, cross and road models, under the Mongoose brand name, and distributes bicycle parts and accessories, including the Advent line of products. Annual sales are about $60 million.
Brunswick makes fishing reels, camping gear, bowling and billiard equipment, pleasure and fishing boats and engines.
